title: The Stock Market Trap Wall Street Set (Earnings, AI Stocks & Oil)
speaker: Arete Trading host

macro_themes.view: Tesla's capex cut, Lam's low-end guide and a $25B state penalty on Meta could push out AI capex and dissolve the memory bottleneck.
A widening France-Germany 10-year spread could unwind a levered carry trade like the yen trade and is a systemic risk.
Money is moving from tech into value, homebuilders, insurers and utilities since around Oct 8.
Mines in the strait and talk of a post-midterm strike raise military risk and put a bid in crude.
